content_metadata.title: Organic farming: Council negotiating position on simpler and clearer organic farming rules agreed
content_metadata.summary: The Council of the EU has agreed on a negotiating position to update the EU rules on organic production and labeling, aiming for simplification and clarity. Key points include exemptions for small operators and clarifications on imported organic products.
content_metadata.subject: Negotiating position on organic farming rules
